data.summary: I added the Desk Lamp to the `PRODUCTS` table in `server.js` under its `lamp` code. I also removed the separate `LAMP` constant and the special case in `lookup()`. The cart endpoint only accepts codes found in `PRODUCTS`, so the lamp was being rejected with "unknown sku lamp" even though the page showed it for sale. I haven't rerun the purchase flow or started the server to check the fix.

data.summary: I changed the free-shipping threshold in `server.js` from 7500 cents ($75) to `FREE_SHIPPING_BANNER_DOLLARS * 100` (5000 cents, $50). The banner already promised free shipping over $50, so the charge logic now uses the same value and a $55 cart ships free. I didn't run the store or re-run the shopper checks after the edit.
